name: cafe-sync
description: A modern **Point of Sale (POS) system** for cafés, built with **MERN stack** and **TypeScript**, featuring **real-time order management**, dashboard reports, and role-based access.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:prod
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
